integrity.claim_scope: Exact singular values, norm-maximizer staircase, norm attainment and Schatten boundary for the specified three-parameter disk operator.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic binomial expansion, beta-gamma identity, exact singular-value ratio and gamma asymptotics; finite checks are supplementary.

limitations: Disk and unweighted L2 only; a,b>-1/2 and c>0; does not treat absolute kernels or weak-type p>q endpoints.
Full texts of arXiv:2609.14552 and Bai–Zhu DOI article unavailable; unindexed earlier overlap remains possible.
title: Arithmetic–geometric norm staircases for two-sided Forelli–Rudin disk operators
